source_evidence.fact: The relocated Mem C++ journey injects an isolated Heap through AllocatorRef and exercises the same public owner used by the host-allocation aggregate.

journeys.consumer: an isolated subsystem heap injected through a runtime-erased allocator
journeys.work: allocate, touch and reverse sized-free 64 deterministic 24 B to 3 KiB blocks with 16/32/64-byte alignment

semantic_equivalence.reason: Both routes perform the same 64 successful allocations, endpoint touches and reverse frees.
Each route owns one distinct heap from the same mimalloc 3.5.1 binary; owner construction, warmup and destruction are outside timing.
The timed steady state contains successful allocations only; OOM behavior is covered by correctness tests.
The same owner thread executes both single-threaded heap lifecycles.
Owner creation and warmup are excluded; all allocation, touch and deallocation operations are charged.
Both routes are in one static artifact, use the same mimalloc 3.5.1 implementation and exact sized-free calls, with LTO disabled.
